onset.Description: Onset of the event, measured from the beginning of the acquisition.

duration.Description: Duration of the event (measured from onset).

go_cue_time_array.Description: time when the go cue is given

result.Description: trial outcome, R: reward, A: abort, F: fail, I: incomplete

target_1_x_position.Description: x position of the first target

target_1_y_position.Description: y position of the first target

target_2_x_position.Description: x position of the second target

target_2_y_position.Description: y position of the second target

target_3_x_position.Description: x position of the third target

target_3_y_position.Description: y position of the third target

target_4_x_position.Description: x position of the fourth target

target_4_y_position.Description: y position of the fourth target

nwb_table.Description: The name of the NWB table from which this event was extracted.

Levels.trials: The 'trials' table in the NWB file.
